API

Public API surface for bounded catalog metadata, hosted-file inventory, publisher releases, and agent workflows.

Developer Quickstart

Install the bay CLI
curl -fsSL "https://huggingbay.xyz/cli/install.sh" | sh
Install the Python SDK
curl -fsSL "https://huggingbay.xyz/sdk/hugging_bay.py" -o hugging_bay.py
Search with the Python SDK
python hugging_bay.py search "rag embedding" --semantic --limit 5
Search with match reasons
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/artifacts?summary=1&q=rag%20memory&limit=5&explain=1"
Resolve an upstream URL
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/resolve?repo=https%3A%2F%2Fhuggingface.co%2Fsentence-transformers%2Fall-MiniLM-L6-v2"
Inspect an agent briefing
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/agents/briefing"
Start high-value activation loops
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/activation"
Inspect hosted model-file inventory
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/hosted-local-models?limit=25"
Get review action templates
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/community/review-actions"
Get AI-search citation guidance
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/ai-search"
Get a citation pack
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/citations?q=open%20AI%20artifact%20metadata"
Get publisher workflow
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/api/agents/publisher-workflow"
Discover MCP tools
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/.well-known/mcp.json"
Inspect browser overlay containment status
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/browser-extension"
Download OpenAPI
curl -s "https://huggingbay.xyz/openapi.json"

POST /api/moderation/reports

GET  /openapi.json
GET  /api/schemas

CLI contract: public commands include account, publisher, search, metadata inspection, file inventory, coverage, source, demand, and readiness-reporting operations. Execution commands are withheld until canonical bundle evaluation is integrated.

Operator-only controls are role-gated and not part of the public crawler or developer surface.
